description: Blog: Instagram ads drive engagement, but without a proper system, those leads get lost in the DMs. This article explains why an Instagram ads manager needs a CRM to track leads from comment to customer and how Mochi helps close the gap.
label: Blog

cover.alt: Instagram ads manager dashboard with DM lead notifications

blocks.name: Content 1
blocks.html:
Ads Manager stops at the click

If you run Instagram ads, you probably watch the metrics inside Meta Ads Manager: impressions, clicks, CTR, and cost per result. When the numbers look good, you feel good. But here is what most advertisers miss. The ads manager tells you how many people clicked or commented. It does not tell you what happened after that.

Somebody comments the keyword you asked for. Your ad manager sees a new lead. But then what? If you are like most coaches, creators, and info businesses, that person falls into your Instagram DMs along with everyone else. Your team replies when they can, follows up when they remember, and hopes the person books a call.

That is not a sales process. That is an inbox doing a job it was never built for. The money you spent on ads is being wasted every time a warm lead waits too long, gets forgotten, or receives a generic message.

Your ads manager gets people to the door. What happens next decides if you make the sale.

blocks.name: Content 2
blocks.html:
The inbox can undo your ad spend

When you run ads, you expect a return. But the return depends on what happens in the DMs, and that is where most businesses lose control.

Instagram shows the newest message at the top of the inbox. So your team answers whoever messaged first, not whoever is most likely to buy. A person who commented on your ad five minutes ago gets a reply before a qualified lead who already asked about pricing and is waiting for a response.

That qualified lead may disappear. They had the problem, they had the budget, they were ready to talk. But they went back to their day because nobody followed up in time.

Worse, when multiple people handle the same Instagram inbox, conversations get messy. One person replies, another follows up with a generic message, and nobody knows who sent the calendar link or when. Your ad budget brought the lead in. A chaotic DM process lost them.

Your ads manager is doing its job. The inbox is undoing it.

blocks.name: Content 3
blocks.html:
Connect Ads Manager to the DM sales process

You do not need a generic CRM that treats your Instagram DMs like email. You need a system built for the way people actually buy on Instagram: through direct messages.

That system needs to do three things.


Prioritize the right conversations

First, it has to help your team focus on the right conversations. Not every comment or DM is a serious lead. Some people just want a freebie. Some are competitors. Some are ready to book. Your DM sales system should sort the serious leads from the noise so your team spends time where it matters.


Preserve the context

Second, it has to give your team the context to have a real conversation. When a lead says they are interested but need to wait two weeks, that information should be visible when someone replies later. No more scrolling through weeks of messages. The system shows the summary, the pain points, and what the person asked for.


Measure the sales outcome

Third, it has to show you what is actually working. Which ad creative brings qualified leads, not just clicks? Which follow-up gets replies? Which team member books the most calls? Without this data, you are guessing which ads to scale and which to kill.

Your Instagram ads manager should connect to the DM sales process, not stop at the click.

blocks.name: Content 4
blocks.html:
How Mochi closes the gap

Mochi is the Instagram DM sales system for coaches, creators, and info businesses that get leads from Instagram. It connects to your Instagram and organizes the conversations your ads and content start.

Here is how Mochi helps you book more calls from the same ad spend.


Prioritize the inbox

It prioritizes your inbox. Qualified leads, follow-ups, and people who already received the calendar link appear above random new messages. Your team works through the conversations that matter most, not just the newest ones.


Give the team context

It gives your team the full context. Conversation summaries show pain points, objections, and important details instantly. Your team can reply like they actually listened, even if someone else handled the chat days ago. Follow-ups are scheduled and sent at the right time so interested people never slip away.


See what creates qualified calls

It shows you what is working. Mochi attributes every conversation back to the ad or content that started it. You can see how many new leads each ad brought, how many became qualified, how many booked a call, and how many became customers. No more guessing which creative is your best performer.


Track team performance

It tracks team performance. You can see which team member is booking the most calls, who needs coaching, and who is just sending messages that go nowhere. That accountability alone changes results.

Mochi is designed to feel like your team finally has the tool they needed. You can start with your own Instagram, invite your team, and use it with the conversations already coming in. The 7-day free trial lets you test it with real ad leads, not a demo.

If you are running Instagram ads and sales depend on the DMs, you cannot afford to treat the inbox like a black box. Your ads bring the leads. Mochi makes sure they become booked calls.
